**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/23 (Tue) 19:55  
[EVENT] User is looking to buy a new pair of running shoes.  
[FACT] User has been using their old running shoes for a while, and they are starting to wear out.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking for running shoes that can provide support and comfort.  
[PREFERENCE] User prefers shoes with good arch support.  
[FACT] User typically runs on roads.  
[FACT] User runs about 3 times a week.  
[FACT] User runs an average distance of 5-7 km.  
[FACT] User does not have any foot or ankle issues.  
[FACT] User's budget for the shoes is around $150.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommends the following running shoes:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. ASICS Gel-Kayano 28: Known for excellent support and stability features.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Brooks Ghost 14: Features a segmented crash pad for smooth heel-to-toe transition.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. New Balance Fresh Foam 1080v12: Offers a comfortable, supportive ride.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Saucony Guide 14: Designed for runners who need a little more support.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggests trying on the ASICS Kayano 28 or the Saucony Guide 14 for good arch support.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommends visiting a specialty running store for guidance on fit and running form.  
[EVENT] User plans to try on both the Kayano 28 and the Ghost 14.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant explains the main differences between the Kayano 28 and the Ghost 14 in terms of support and cushioning:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Kayano 28: More supportive with a pronounced medial post for overpronation correction.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ghost 14: More neutral support profile, suitable for runners with neutral to mild overpronation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Kayano 28: FlyteFoam midsole for a softer ride, but firmer than Ghost 14.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ghost 14: DNA LOFT midsole for a softer, more cushioned ride.  
[EVENT] User considers trying the New Balance Fresh Foam 1080v12.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant clarifies that the Fresh Foam 1080v12 is suitable for runners with medium to high arches.
